claim: The leaderboard that main.py prints lists the three players tied on 30 points in the order Zoe, ana, ben, all at rank 2, and eli is at rank 5.
why: The scores are sorted by name first, and plain string order puts the capital Zoe before ana and ben. The second sort with reverse=True keeps equal items in their existing order, so the ties stay Zoe, ana, ben. Ranks are shared on ties and skip after them, so eli is 5.
